title.zh: 伊朗重申霍尔木兹海峡将保持关闭，并称将很快封锁「非法」航道
title.en: 伊朗重申霍尔木兹海峡将保持关闭，并称将很快封锁「非法」航道

current_state.zh: 伊朗已同意一项有条件的两天计划，霍尔木兹海峡将在美国第一天采取履约措施后第二天开放；但该计划尚未执行，海峡目前仍处于关闭状态，谈判需待美国履行条件后才能重启。
current_state.en: Iran has agreed to a conditional two-day plan under which the Strait of Hormuz would reopen on day two after US compliance measures on day one; the plan has not been implemented and the strait remains closed, with talks contingent on US fulfillment of conditions.

updates.title_zh: 伊朗重申霍尔木兹海峡将保持关闭，并称将很快封锁「非法」航道
updates.title_en: 伊朗重申霍尔木兹海峡将保持关闭，并称将很快封锁「非法」航道
updates.what_changed_zh: 伊朗重申，在其要求得到满足之前，霍尔木兹海峡将保持关闭。伊斯兰革命卫队一名顾问表示，德黑兰很快将关闭该海峡的“非法”航道。
updates.what_changed_en: Iran reiterated that the Strait of Hormuz will remain closed until its demands are met, with an IRGC adviser saying Tehran will soon shut down 'illegal' shipping lanes in the strait.

updates.title_zh: 伊朗外长披露“两天计划”，美方履约方能重启伊美谈判
updates.title_en: 伊朗外长披露“两天计划”，美方履约方能重启伊美谈判
updates.what_changed_zh: 伊朗外长披露一项“两天计划”：第一天美国采取一系列履约措施，第二天霍尔木兹海峡开放并恢复交通；在美国履行包括确定新航线、解冻资金、结束海上封锁、解除新制裁等条件后，伊美谈判才会重启。
updates.what_changed_en: Iran's foreign minister disclosed a 'two-day plan': on day one the US takes a series of compliance measures, and on day two the Strait of Hormuz reopens and traffic returns to normal; talks would resume only after the US fulfills conditions including new shipping routes, unfrozen Iranian funds, an end to the naval blockade, and new sanctions relief.
updates.current_state_zh: 伊朗已同意一项有条件的两天计划，霍尔木兹海峡将在美国第一天采取履约措施后第二天开放；但该计划尚未执行，海峡目前仍处于关闭状态，谈判需待美国履行条件后才能重启。
updates.current_state_en: Iran has agreed to a conditional two-day plan under which the Strait of Hormuz would reopen on day two after US compliance measures on day one; the plan has not been implemented and the strait remains closed, with talks contingent on US fulfillment of conditions.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Iran's foreign minister said Tehran has agreed to a 'two-day plan' in which the US takes a series of compliance measures on day one and the Strait of Hormuz reopens on day two, with talks resuming only after Washington fulfills conditions including new shipping routes, unfrozen Iranian funds, an end to the naval blockade and new sanctions relief.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Iran's foreign minister said Tehran has agreed to a 'two-day plan' in which the US takes a series of compliance measures on day one and the Strait of Hormuz reopens on day two, with talks resuming only after Washington fulfills conditions including new shipping routes, unfrozen Iranian funds, an end to the naval blockade and new sanctions relief.
